scope: Static causal/noncausal bounded-copy probe versus retained variant and unchanged reference. Diagnostic comparison; no claim that copy metrics predict latency.
conclusion: Dropping ZFILL halves the reported copy-specific shared wavefront counts to the reference values, but immediate LDSM-to-HMMA dependencies and large short-scoreboard sample populations return. This corroborates a scheduling regression that can mask a copy-form benefit; neither benefit nor penalty is isolated as an exact timing contribution.
